name: Graduation
tagline: Cap, gown and the proudest smile on campus.
description: University and postgraduate commencement photos: campus lawns, cap tosses, library steps, stoles and honor cords, sunflower bouquets, the walk across the stage, a celebratory pop of bubbly and doctoral regalia. Bright, proud and frame-worthy.
